page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine configuration based on the KVM hypervisor. It runs on the x86_64 architecture and is driven by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The instance allocates 16 dedicated virtual CPUs derived from 8 physical cores via hyper-threading. The memory configuration includes 64.0 GB of RAM, offering a standardized 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio (4.0 GB per core). Cache resources include 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 33 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, and AES cryptographic instructions, but omit newer vector extensions like AVX-512 VNNI or AMX.

Benchmark outcomes show mid-tier multi-threaded capabilities paired with constrained single-core throughput. The instance achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 906.0 and single-core stress-ng rating of 1105.59, both placing it in the bottom tiers of per-thread execution speed. Single-threaded gzip compression (19.0 GB/sec) and bzip3 decompression (7.07 GB/sec) reflect these limitations. However, multi-threaded metrics perform moderately across standard benchmarks, reaching a multi-core Geekbench score of 6825.0, a PassMark CPU score of 17461.37, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression of 49.1 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth tops out at 78.8 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 47.29 GB/sec for writes.

The ecs.n2.3xlarge comes with no local NVMe storage and zero bundled GPUs, requiring cloud network storage for persistent file systems and boot volumes. It also includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Given the age and clock speed of the underlying Xeon 8163 processor, the server offers functional cost-effective density for multi-threaded batch operations rather than low-latency single-thread processing.

This server type is suitable for scale-out parallel workloads that benefit from 16 vCPUs without requiring peak per-core speed. Typical deployment fits include static web serving, Clang compilation pipelines, backend services, Redis caching pools, and intermediate database operations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.3xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose instance featuring an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. It provisions 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores alongside 64.0 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. The instance lacks local storage and GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage for disk operations. Benchmark metrics reveal average multi-core and multi-threaded performance, as indicated by a PassMark CPU score of 17461.37 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 6825.0, contrasted by weaker single-core processing capabilities. With AVX-512 and AES support, the ecs.n2.3xlarge fits moderately threaded general workloads, including static web serving, Redis caching, software compilation, and routine multi-threaded backend batch services.
